title: Puharich letter admits Israeli-US mind control program at Aberdeen Proving Grounds
summary: Greg tells of Puharich letter admits Israeli-US mind control program at Aberdeen Proving Grounds, about unspecified at Aberdeen Proving Grounds, Maryland, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he, um, basically admitted to being part of a Israeli US, um, mind con, you know, mind control program that was happening at Aberdeen Proving Grounds,

plain: A researcher named Greg told podcast host Jesse Michels about a letter Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA, the US intelligence agency, wrote to his bookkeeper and confidant. Greg says that in it Puharich basically admitted being part of a joint Israeli and American mind control program run at Aberdeen Proving Grounds, a US Army testing site in Maryland. If true, it would mean two governments were secretly experimenting on controlling people's minds.
